input: 204 small-variant records on chromosome 21 selected from a pool of 1,750 candidates: the chromosome 21 records of the committed GRCh38 golden corpora, a sample of the clinically associated variants and a sample of the common variants of Ensembl release 116's chromosome 21 variation set, without symbolic or breakend alleles and without any record Ensembl VEP's --everything co-locates with a COSMIC or HGMD-PUBLIC identifier; one exemplar per consequence-set combination the pool shows under --everything, stratified by variant class, strand and the presence of the frequency, clinical and identifier columns the family columns name; the records inside a regulatory feature or a transcription-factor binding motif carry RegulatoryFeature or MotifFeature rows in the reference, which the manifest's mask class sets aside
generator: candidate records annotated with Ensembl VEP under the corpus flags, then scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --suite everything=<reference>=<candidates> --k 1 --seed 1 --cache <converted slice> --flank 5000 --covers everything --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --family-columns MAX_AF,AF,CLIN_SIG,PUBMED,SOMATIC,miRNA,GENE_PHENO,DOMAINS,SIFT,MANE_PLUS_CLINICAL --flag=--everything; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except <the transcripts whose rows carry SIFT or PolyPhen> --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 --variations <cache> --exclude-variation '^COSV\d' --exclude-variation '^(C[A-Z]|BM|HM)\d{6}' over the chromosome 21 slice scripts/data/storable_to_json.pl converted from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh38 cache (protein features kept on every transcript, prediction matrices on the 359 transcripts that print SIFT or PolyPhen); scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify over the reference with its RegulatoryFeature and MotifFeature rows removed, the manifest's masks

variation_slice.source: homo_sapiens/116_GRCh38/21/all_vars.gz of the Ensembl VEP release-116 indexed cache
variation_slice.window: records whose start lies within one base of an input record's span
variation_slice.slice_check: the golden comparison: vep-rs on this slice writes the Existing_variation, frequency, CLIN_SIG, PHENO and PUBMED values Ensembl VEP 116.2 wrote on the full cache for every record

divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with
